replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I haven't really used AI for math recently. When I did try a few times, it helped clarify some concepts but didn't fully replace my traditional study methods.
replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: To solve a quadratic equation ax^2+bx+c=0, first check if a is nonzero. Then compute the discriminant D=b^2-4ac. If D>0, two real roots exist; if D=0, one repeated root exists; if D<0, roots are complex. Finally, apply x=(-b±√D)/(2a).
To find stationary points, differentiate f(x) to get f'(x), then set f'(x)=0 and solve for x. These x-values are where the slope is zero; plug them back into f(x) to get corresponding y-coordinates.
